title: head-fingerprint — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the deterministic head_id -> SAS bootstrap/fork-audit fingerprint (SYNC-17; spec docs/spec/sync-protocol.md §6.3). A short, eye-comparable code both devices display at the enrollment approval gate (MYND-425) and the general fork-audit UI reuses (MYND-427). Encoding: digest = SHA-256('myne.v0.1 vault-head-fingerprint' || head_id); the first 40 bits are emitted as 8 Crockford-base32 chars (account-number.md §4 alphabet, excluding I/L/O/U), grouped XXXX-XXXX. Cross-implementation byte-identical output is the acceptance bar (PRIMITIVE-LEVEL review). Reference: protocol::head_fingerprint.

input_head_id_hex.description: 32-byte head_id (hex), the SHA-256(record) the fingerprint is derived from.

expected_fingerprint.description: The 8-char Crockford-base32 SAS, grouped XXXX-XXXX (I/L/O/U excluded by the alphabet).
